name: Kikuyō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kikuyō town emblem in yellow: a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke with a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kikuyō, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 31 March 1986; the emblem dates from 1 April 1972.

features.role: Kikuyō town emblem — a disc crossed by a diagonal stroke with a small ring
